title: The re-kit at Lumbridge
caption: Seconds after the recovery login, a helper trades the rebuilt kit across: the cannonballs, the potions and the food. Then the account teleports out for the Wilderness.

title: The cannon goes down
caption: The run to the poison spiders ends, and the run's last combat step begins: the cannon goes down piece by piece and the account fights beside it.

title: Agility 99
caption: The last obstacles of the Wilderness Agility Course, the level-up that made every skill 99, and the runner logging out.

title: The whole recovery
caption: All 41 minutes, from the login at Lumbridge to the logout on the Agility course, for scrubbing through.
